map.基本偏差字母含义？: What do the fundamental deviation letters mean?
map.大写孔、小写轴；H 为孔基准（下偏差 0），h 为轴基准（上偏差 0）；a–zc: Uppercase for holes, lowercase for shafts; H is the hole basis (lower deviation 0) and h the shaft basis (upper deviation 0); the different positions of the a-zc deviations determine how tight the fit is.
map.配合公差大说明什么？: What does a large fit tolerance indicate?
